news.title: We owe Cardi B — and all working mothers — an apology
news.summary: In light of Cardi B’s 2027 Grammy Awards nomination, HR Dive reporter Caroline Colvin revisits decade-old claims the rapper would never be successful as a working mother.

news.title: Former Uber worker alleges disability bias after termination following work-from-home accommodation
news.summary: The worker was fired a couple weeks into her new arrangement, but Uber relied on her not following a policy she’d never been trained on, she said.

news.title: Many companies use AI, but few pair it with culture changes, report says
news.summary: CHROs who emphasize the connection between culture and artificial intelligence tool use were “twice as likely to sustain superior market performance,” per a new report.

news.title: Dishonesty and unprotected absences, not FMLA use, caused CSX to fire workers, court rules
news.summary: One worker had taken leave on Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Superbowl Sunday, Valentine’s Day and Easter Sunday — despite previous warnings.

news.title: Court blocks DHS policy limiting international student training opportunities
news.summary: The higher education groups suing to strike down new limits on the Curricular Practical Training program are likely to succeed, a federal judge ruled.

news.title: Training is key to AI adoption — but is still hitting roadblocks
news.summary: Unbalanced access to artificial intelligence tool training may limit broader uptake and stifle company transformation, some studies show.

news.title: Fox TV fired news host with facial disability because viewers mocked her appearance, lawsuit alleges
news.summary: The station’s news director allegedly believed the online comments would hurt the station and his career, according to the complaint.

news.title: Congress’ landmark law protecting pregnant workers is unconstitutional, court holds
news.summary: The decision renders the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act unenforceable against the state of Texas, but other employers must still comply with the law, observers cautioned.

news.title: What are ‘buffer spaces’ at work? Here’s what HR should know.
news.summary: When faced with harassment, workers may benefit from a middle ground between informal conversations and formal reporting, researchers theorized.

news.title: DOL proposes removing ESG references from 401(k) rule
news.summary: The proposed rule would also seek to place a “heightened focus” on fund managers’ shareholder engagement and proxy voting activities.
